Get the converged candidate with the lowest value of each information criterion

Source: R/wildcards.R
get_best.Rd

get_best() returns, for each information criterion of an enumeration grid, the converged candidate with the lowest value. Several criteria may name the same candidate, and no criterion chooses a model on its own.

Usage

get_best(x)

Arguments

x

An enumeration grid from enumerate_lpa(), enumerate_lca() or enumerate_classes(). A regression grid from enumerate_regressions() has no such table and is refused; its get_candidates() table marks the lowest BIC in best_bic.

Value

A data frame.

On a profile or class grid it has one row per criterion and sample size, with the columns:

  • criterion: aic, kic, bic, sabic, caic, awe, icl or clc;

  • convention: "groups" or "individuals", the sample size the criterion uses; NA for AIC and KIC, which use none;

  • candidate: the name of the converged candidate with the lowest value;

  • n_profiles, n_group_classes, model: that candidate's numbers of classes and covariance structure;

  • value: its value of the criterion.

On a transition grid or a grid of group-class families it is one row: the row of get_results(x, "candidates") with the lowest BIC.

Errors: latents_bad_argument for a regression grid, naming the tables it has; latents_not_a_fit when x is not an enumeration grid.

See also

get_candidates() for every candidate and criterion; get_deltas(), get_knees(); plot_criteria().

Examples

grid <- enumerate_lpa(faithful, c("eruptions", "waiting"),
                      n_profiles = 1:3, model = "EEI",
                      n_starts = 2, seed = 1)
get_best(grid)
#>    criterion  convention candidate n_profiles n_group_classes model    value
#> 1        aic        <NA> profiles3          3               1   EEI 2286.911
#> 2        kic        <NA> profiles3          3               1   EEI 2299.911
#> 3        bic      groups profiles3          3               1   EEI 2322.969
#> 4        bic individuals profiles3          3               1   EEI 2322.969
#> 5      sabic      groups profiles3          3               1   EEI 2291.262
#> 6      sabic individuals profiles3          3               1   EEI 2291.262
#> 7       caic      groups profiles3          3               1   EEI 2332.969
#> 8       caic individuals profiles3          3               1   EEI 2332.969
#> 9        awe      groups profiles2          2               1   EEI 2417.507
#> 10       awe individuals profiles2          2               1   EEI 2417.507
#> 11       icl      groups profiles2          2               1   EEI 2357.266
#> 12       icl individuals profiles2          2               1   EEI 2357.266
#> 13       clc      groups profiles2          2               1   EEI 2318.026
#> 14       clc individuals profiles2          2               1   EEI 2318.026
